deck_02_irl_oae_date_mastery.title: IRL OAE Date Mastery & Logistics Pack

cards.title: The Corporate Job Trap
cards.badMove: So what do you do for work? Do you like working in consulting?
cards.goodMove: You have that intense product-manager energy. Tell me you don't obsess over Jira tickets on Sunday nights [work archetype ✎].
cards.hinglish: Job interview mat lo, uski corporate identity ko playfully roast karo.

cards.title: The College / Alma Mater Interrogation
cards.badMove: Where did you go to college? Did you study engineering or commerce?
cards.goodMove: Don't tell me—you definitely went to [St. Stephen's / SRCC ✎] and still judge people who say 'espresso' wrong.
cards.hinglish: Factual background poochna bore karta hai; exaggerated stereotype feko taaki wo defend kare.

cards.title: The Weekend Agenda Drill
cards.badMove: What are your plans for this weekend? Doing anything fun?
cards.goodMove: Prediction: You're either plotting world domination at [Blue Tokai ✎] or sleeping till 2 PM watching true crime. There is no in-between.
cards.hinglish: Weekend plans mat pucho; binary absurd choice do taaki curiosity spike ho.

cards.title: The Travel Resume Recital
cards.badMove: How was your trip to Goa? Which beaches did you visit?
cards.goodMove: Look at [3rd photo ✎]—that's either a spiritual awakening or 4 tequila shots in Vagator. Which one was it?
cards.hinglish: Itinerary review mat banao; specific visual detail se vibe tease nikalo.

cards.title: The Hometown Census
cards.badMove: Are you originally from Delhi or Mumbai? How long have you lived here?
cards.goodMove: You walk with proper [South Bombay ✎] entitlement, but order food like a true Delhi street foodie. Where are you actually from?
cards.hinglish: Census bureau banna band karo; contrasting traits identify karke playfully call out karo.

cards.title: The Music / Spotify Vibe Check
cards.badMove: What kind of music do you listen to? Who is your favorite artist?
cards.goodMove: If your top Spotify artist is [Prateek Kuhad ✎], our car privileges are permanently revoked. Convince me you have better taste.
cards.hinglish: Generic recommendations mat maango; musical dealbreaker ka playful hurdle create karo.

cards.title: The Pet Photo Fluff
cards.badMove: Aw what a cute dog! What breed is he and what's his name?
cards.goodMove: Your golden retriever [dog's name ✎] clearly runs your household. Be honest, who walks whom?
cards.hinglish: Cute cute mat karo, doggy ko household ka real boss declare karke power dynamic flip karo.

cards.title: The 'How Was Your Day' Boredom
cards.badMove: Hey, how was your day today? Mine was so busy with work haha.
cards.goodMove: Rate your Tuesday out of 10: 1 being [endless Zoom calls ✎] and 10 being finding free fries at the bottom of the bag.
cards.hinglish: Boring formal greeting ko quantifiable absurd scale pe transform karo.

cards.title: The Hobbies Checklist
cards.badMove: What do you like to do in your free time when you're not working?
cards.goodMove: Tell me your most controversial weekend passion—and if you say 'reading books and cafe hopping [cafe vibe ✎]', I'm deducting points.
cards.hinglish: Generic hobby list expect karne ke bajaye cliché answers pe playful penalty lagao.

cards.title: The Sibling / Family Question
cards.badMove: Do you have any brothers or sisters? Older or younger?
cards.goodMove: Total oldest daughter energy in [4th photo ✎]. You definitely micromanaged your younger siblings' homework.
cards.hinglish: Direct family interrogations weird lagti hain; personality cues se psychological guess karo.

cards.title: The Single-Word 'Haha' Reply
cards.badMove: Haha yeah! So what else is going on with you? Did you do anything today?
cards.goodMove: Dangerous levels of enthusiasm in that text [her name ✎]. Don't exhaust yourself 😂
cards.hinglish: Desperation se energy mat supply karo; dry response pe gentle tease feko taaki wo step up kare.

cards.title: The 18-Hour Gap with Zero Apology
cards.badMove: Hey, why did you disappear? Did I say something wrong or are you mad?
cards.goodMove: Survived the day without your witty commentary, but just barely. Welcome back from the underworld [teasing nickname ✎].
cards.hinglish: Guilt-trip kabhi kaam nahi karta; non-needy welcome back se status anchor hold karo.

cards.title: The Vague 'Maybe / Let's See' Stall
cards.badMove: Okay cool, whenever you are free just let me know, I'm completely free this weekend!
cards.goodMove: 'Maybe' is the enemy of great coffee [spot name ✎]. Lock it in or I'm taking my friend who actually appreciates flat whites.
cards.hinglish: Availability unlimited dikhana value giraata hai; playful takeaway se decision accelerate karo.

cards.title: The Hot-and-Cold Emoji Barrage
cards.badMove: 😍🔥❤️❤️ You look so unbelievably stunning! Why don't you reply to my compliments?
cards.goodMove: You're sending mixed signals faster than [Mumbai traffic ✎]. Pick a lane, troublemaker.
cards.hinglish: Over-complimenting band karo; unki unpredictable vibe ko acknowledge karke game playfully call out karo.

cards.title: The 'I'm Bad at Texting' Excuse
cards.badMove: Oh haha no worries at all! I understand! You must be very important!
cards.goodMove: Admitting to being a terrible texter before the first date is brave [city name ✎]. Voice note test incoming to see if you can hold a conversation.
cards.hinglish: Excuse ko excuse mat maano; channel upgrade (voice note/call) ka pivot excuse bana lo.

cards.title: The Passive 'WYD' Late Night Ping
cards.badMove: Nothing just lying in bed thinking about you! What are you doing? Are you awake?
cards.goodMove: Curfew was 11 PM [time anchor ✎]. If you want a late-night debate, you better bring a controversial hot take.
cards.hinglish: Booty-call low-effort prompt pe immediately surrender mat karo; verbal barrier raise karo.

cards.title: Left on Delivered for 24h Then View Your Story
cards.badMove: Saw you viewed my story haha... so why didn't you reply to my message?
cards.goodMove: Spotted in my story viewers. You're an undercover lurker [detective emoji ✎], I respect the stealth.
cards.hinglish: Creep banke monitor mat dikho; unki lurking ko playful spy agency ka narrative de do.

cards.title: The Enthusiastic Text Followed by Sudden Ghost
cards.badMove: ???? Are you alive? Did your phone die or what happened?
cards.goodMove: I'll assume you were kidnapped by [Blinkit delivery ninjas ✎]. Send a blinking emoji if you need rescue.
cards.hinglish: Panic attack text mat bhejo; absurd humor se tension dilute karo bina ego hurt kiye.

cards.title: The 'Haha Cool' Conversation Ender
cards.badMove: Yeah totally! Anyway, so do you have any fun plans for next week?
cards.goodMove: End of thread detected. Resetting simulation [pause 24h ✎]. Catch you on the flip side.
cards.hinglish: Mari hui conversation ko CPR mat do; drop karo gracefully, ball unke court me chhodo.

cards.title: The Cryptic 'Men are exhausting' Vent
cards.badMove: I'm not like other guys! What happened? Who hurt you? You can vent to me!
cards.goodMove: Hey, leave me out of your general grievance forum [city guys ✎]. I'm an innocent bystander with exceptional taste.
cards.hinglish: 'Nice guy' therapist banke validation mat baanto; exempt yourself with cheeky confidence.

cards.title: The Exaggeration Answer Rule
cards.badMove: I work as an equity research analyst covering banking stocks in BKC.
cards.goodMove: I run high-stakes covert financial schemes for billionaire moguls. On LinkedIn I pretend to write spreadsheet formulas [office tower ✎].
cards.hinglish: Factual inquiry ka dry jawab mat do; scale up the fantasy to trigger an emotional reaction.

cards.title: The Playful Disqualification
cards.badMove: I love everything you love! We are so compatible and have so much in common!
cards.goodMove: You like pineapple on pizza? Tragically, this romance is terminated before it even started [culinary crime ✎]. We can only be enemies.
cards.hinglish: Desperate compatibility create mat karo; mock dealbreaker se sexual tension build karo.

cards.title: The Standard Setting Barrier
cards.badMove: I will take you wherever you want! Any restaurant, my treat, you just name it!
cards.goodMove: I only do drinks with people who have strong opinions on [favorite band/dish ✎] and zero patience for small talk. Do you qualify?
cards.hinglish: Unlimited accessibility loser energy deti hai; criteria impose karo taaki wo win over karna chahe.

cards.title: The Roleplay Dynamic Starter
cards.badMove: You look like a fun travel partner. We should travel together sometime!
cards.goodMove: In our bank heist movie, you're definitely the getaway driver who panics and crashes into [local landmark ✎], and I'm the mastermind.
cards.hinglish: Hypothetical funny scenario banao jisme tum dono partner-in-crime ban jao.

cards.title: The Premature Compliment Pivot
cards.badMove: You have the most beautiful eyes and smile I've ever seen on this app.
cards.goodMove: Great style in [outfit photo ✎], but aesthetics are easy. Are you actually funny under pressure or is that just curated PR?
cards.hinglish: Looks ki tareef sab karte hain; personality and wit ko test karo.

cards.title: The Time Constraint Opener
cards.badMove: I'm sitting here all night with nothing to do, tell me your whole life story.
cards.goodMove: I have exactly 7 minutes before [impending meeting / workout ✎], give me your most unhinged opinion on pop culture.
cards.hinglish: Time pressure signals you have a busy life and stops the convo from dragging into boredom.

cards.title: The 'Troublemaker' Accusation
cards.badMove: Haha no I swear I'm a really nice decent guy, I never get into trouble!
cards.goodMove: Takes one to know one. I have a feeling you are the real bad influence here [trouble emoji ✎].
cards.hinglish: Defense me aana weakness hai; playful accusation ko instantly reverse karo.

cards.title: The Subtle Pull-Away After Good Banter
cards.badMove: Keep chatting please don't go! What else do you think about astrology?
cards.goodMove: Okay you're actually witty. Pausing this before you get too addicted to my banter [gym/work anchor ✎]. Catch you tomorrow.
cards.hinglish: Conversation peak pe disconnect karo taaki agle din anticipation rahe.

cards.title: The Flirtatious Disagreement
cards.badMove: Oh yeah totally, whatever you say is right, I agree with you completely!
cards.goodMove: Hard disagree. [Christopher Nolan / Quentin Tarantino ✎] is a genius, and your hot take belongs in quarantine.
cards.hinglish: People-pleasing agreement attraction killer hai; respectful but unapologetic stance lo.

cards.title: The Micro-Investment Challenge
cards.badMove: Can you send me a long paragraph about your favorite books so I know more about you?
cards.goodMove: Send me the one song on your playlist that you're too embarrassed to admit you love [audio hook ✎]. No judgment.
cards.hinglish: Chhota, fun compliance maango jo unko vulnerable aur engaged banaye.

cards.title: The 72-Hour Zero-Guilt Resurrection
cards.badMove: Hey, did you see my last text? Did you forget to reply?
cards.goodMove: Breaking news: Local cafe made a croissant so good I briefly forgot you left me on read [croissant photo ✎].
cards.hinglish: Chot khaaye aashiq mat bano; life is moving on, unko casually onboard karo.

cards.title: The Accidental Witness Callback
cards.badMove: Hey... still there? Wondering if you're still interested in talking?
cards.goodMove: Just passed someone in [Khan Market / Indiranagar ✎] arguing passionately about iced lattes and immediately thought of your rant.
cards.hinglish: Conversation ko external trigger se connect karo, text delay ko ignore karo.

cards.title: The Binary Meme Diagnostic
cards.badMove: Why does everyone ghost nowadays? It's so rude honestly.
cards.goodMove: A: Swallowed by a sinkhole. B: Winning the lottery and moving to Monaco. Select your excuse [meme sticker ✎].
cards.hinglish: Passive aggression ke badle playful multiple choice test do.

cards.title: The Voice Note Energy Pivot
cards.badMove: Can you text back please? I hate texting when people don't reply.
cards.goodMove: Voice note [12 sec ✎]: 'Texting has expired. Dropping this voice memo because typing feels like 2012.'
cards.hinglish: Text fatigue todne ke liye audio dimension introduce karo.

cards.title: The Overdue Bet Closure
cards.badMove: Hey do you remember what we talked about last Monday?
cards.goodMove: You owe me a cold brew. [Arsenal / Real Madrid ✎] won just like I told you they would. Pay up.
cards.hinglish: Previous playful bet ko leverage karo, no awkward transition needed.

cards.title: The Disappearing Act Roast
cards.badMove: You're clearly not interested so I won't bother you anymore bye.
cards.goodMove: David Copperfield level disappearing trick [magic wand ✎]. Honestly impressed by the dedication.
cards.hinglish: Rona-dhona band; silence ko magic show ka compliment bana ke roast karo.

cards.title: The Sudden Epiphany Hook
cards.badMove: Hey so what's new with you? Anything exciting?
cards.goodMove: I just realized the biggest red flag in your Hinge profile [prompt name ✎] and now I can't unsee it.
cards.hinglish: Open loop create karo; curiosity itch unko reply karne pe compel karegi.

cards.title: The Clean Slate Reset
cards.badMove: Sorry if I texted too much or bothered you earlier!
cards.goodMove: Let's pretend that previous conversation suffered a tragic server fire. Starting over: Hello [witty greeting ✎].
cards.hinglish: Apologize kabhi mat karo unke silence ke liye; timeline reboot karo.

cards.title: The Food Recommendation Re-engage
cards.badMove: Hey where did you say that good pizza place was again?
cards.goodMove: Urgent dilemma: Ordering sushi in [neighborhood ✎] and need your definitive veto on whether spicy tuna is safe here.
cards.hinglish: High-urgency specific opinion maang ke low-stakes interaction trigger karo.

cards.title: The Dignified Final Exit
cards.badMove: Why are you ignoring me? You could have at least been polite!
cards.goodMove: Looks like the signal faded in the clouds. Take care and stay out of trouble [salute emoji ✎].
cards.hinglish: Graceful exit keeps doors open forever; bitter texts lock them shut permanently.

cards.title: The Bandra Flat White Anchor
cards.badMove: Are you free sometime this weekend maybe if you're not busy?
cards.goodMove: I'm grabbing flat whites at [Blue Tokai Bandra ✎] Thursday 6:30 PM. Join for 20 mins, if you're boring I'll leave.
cards.hinglish: Vague invite reject hoti hai; specific time + place + low-investment exit clause win karta hai.

cards.title: The Text-to-Audio Transition
cards.badMove: Can I call you? Are you free to talk on the phone?
cards.goodMove: My thumbs are officially on strike. Sending this voice note—reply with your actual voice or lose talking points [audio icon ✎].
cards.hinglish: Permission mat maango; lead karo audio medium me naturally.

cards.title: The Anti-Dinner Date Policy
cards.badMove: Can I take you to a fancy 5-course dinner at Bastian this Saturday?
cards.goodMove: First meetings should never feel like job performance reviews over pasta. Casual drinks at [rooftop bar ✎] for an hour, deal?
cards.hinglish: Heavy dinner trap avoid karo; high-pressure awkwardness se bacho, keep it dynamic.

cards.title: The Schedule Clash Counter
cards.badMove: Oh no you're busy? That sucks... whenever you're free just tell me.
cards.goodMove: No sweat, crush your deadlines. I'm booked Friday anyway—let's do [Tuesday 7 PM ✎] instead.
cards.hinglish: Passive wait mode me mat jao; busy status convey karke solid counter-date propose karo.

cards.title: The Venue Shift Mid-Date Hook
cards.badMove: Do you want to stay here or do you want to go somewhere else? Whatever you want.
cards.goodMove: This spot is turning into an IT conference. Follow me, there's a hidden gelato place around the corner [gelato spot ✎].
cards.hinglish: Indecisive mat bano; venue switch se emotional intimacy double hoti hai.

cards.title: The Post-Date High-Vibe Ping
cards.badMove: Did you reach home safely? Did you have a good time? Did you like me?
cards.goodMove: Admit it, my taste in cocktails is superior [cocktail name ✎]. Great meeting you tonight, trouble.
cards.hinglish: Insecure validation fishing band karo; strong banter callback se date conclude karo.

cards.title: The Number / WhatsApp Soft Close
cards.badMove: Can I have your WhatsApp number please if you don't mind?
cards.goodMove: Hinge notifications are atrocious. Move this over to WhatsApp: [phone number ✎] so I don't lose your meme.
cards.hinglish: App ki glitchiness ko blame karo, smooth transition create karo.

cards.title: The Interactive Activity Pivot
cards.badMove: Do you want to just sit and talk somewhere for hours?
cards.goodMove: Sitting across a table is boring. Let's hit the [arcade / driving range ✎]—loser pays for the tacos.
cards.hinglish: Side-by-side activity tension kam karti hai aur natural touch/banter facilitate karti hai.

cards.title: The Soft Time Constraint on First Date
cards.badMove: I cleared my entire evening for you! I have no plans after this!
cards.goodMove: I've got a [dinner with friends ✎] at 9, but let's grab a quick drink at 7:30. Short and sweet.
cards.hinglish: Boundaries safety deti hain; women feel comfortable knowing there's a defined exit.

cards.title: The Flirtatious Physicality Bridge
cards.badMove: Can I hold your hand? Is it okay if I sit closer to you?
cards.goodMove: Your hands are freezing [ring comment ✎]. How do you survive winter with zero circulation?
cards.hinglish: Observation ke through natural touch introduce karo bina awkward verbal permission ke.
